Push the two (ON) push bottom

Components
The PLC system consist of:
Programmable logic controller C 100 consists of the following units:
One 
 control unit type (5120 - 8)
One

One 
 coupler type (5800)
One 
 RS232 interface (58X1)
Two 
 modules for analog inputs type (5212)
One 
 module for logic inputs type (5211)
Two 
 module for logic outputs type (5302)
One 
 module for analog outputs 1/5v type (5315.V)
One 
 module for analog outputs 4/20 mA type (5315.I)

 carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
